summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for pip editable mode installation in Python development environments. It differs semantically and contextually from existing skills (Spring Boot observation conventions, Flink setup) which operate in different domains and technology stacks. Peer candidates (pre-commit hooks, test dependencies, AgentOps) are related but separate workflow steps in the same environment_setup task family. The candidate has support evidence from Debugging Roadmap and no conflicts. It should be created as a new capability.
